correctness.rationale: Boolean-cube Parseval gives the exact collision formula from the full Pauli-correlation tensors. The Gram determinant and frame-operator eigenvalue inequality prove the continuous bound for arbitrary four unit Bloch axes; equality is equivalent to rank one of the frame operator. The included exact checker independently replays every Pauli component and the Gram polynomial identity. No sampling or timeout is used as proof.
